def test_stale_finish():
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    # finish id1 after id2 begun should be stale
    rows1 = ['x']
    ok1 = v.finish(id1, rows1)  # should succeed (first finish)
    assert ok1 == True
    # finish id1 again should be False
    ok1b = v.finish(id1, ['x2'])
    assert ok1b == False
    # finish id2 (latest) should succeed
    rows2 = ['y']
    ok2 = v.finish(id2, rows2)
    assert ok2 == True
    # finish id1 now stale (latest_id is id2) should be False
    ok1c = v.finish(id1, ['z'])
    assert ok1c == False
    # rows after id2 finish should be rows2
    assert v.get_rows() == rows2
    # notes unchanged (no notes set yet)
    assert v.notes == {}

def test_notes_preserved():
    v = view.View()
    v.notes['job1'] = 'note1'
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    # notes stay
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'
    rows1 = ['a']
    v.finish(id1, rows1)
    # notes still there
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    v.notes['job2'] = 'note2'
    rows2 = ['b']
    v.finish(id2, rows2)
    # both notes preserved
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'
    assert v.notes['job2'] == 'note2'
    # rows from id2
    assert v.get_rows() == rows2

def test_loading_cleared():
    v = view.View()
    v.set_loading(True)
    assert v.get_loading() == True
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    # begin clears loading errors (loading becomes False)
    assert v.get_loading() == False
    # finish does not set loading back to True
    rows1 = ['a']
    v.finish(id1, rows1)
    assert v.get_loading() == False

def run_all():
    test_basic()
    test_stale_finish()
    test_notes_preserved()
    test_loading_cleared()
    print('All tests passed')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    run_all()
